metadata.title: Privacy Policy | Impact Words
metadata.description: Learn how Impact Words collects, uses, retains and protects personal data submitted through its website and forms.

hero.title: Privacy
hero.intro: Transparency matters. This page explains how {company} processes personal data when you visit the website or contact us with an enquiry.

controller.title: Who is responsible for your data?
controller.intro: The data controller responsible for the personal data processing described in this policy is the sole trader operating under the trading name {company}.
controller.legalIntro: Legal information about the website publisher is available on our

data.title: What data do we collect?
data.intro: The data collected depends on the information you voluntarily provide through our forms or share during your communications with Impact Words.

contact.label: Contact details:
contact.text: email address, phone number if requested, and any other contact details you choose to provide.

project.label: Project information:
project.text: the purpose of your enquiry, your stated needs, project description, budget or timeline, where requested.

exchanges.label: Communications:
exchanges.text: messages you send and replies needed to follow up on your enquiry.

technical.label: Technical data:
technical.text: certain connection details or security logs may be processed by the hosting provider or technical services used, depending on their configuration.

data.warning: Do not submit sensitive data or confidential information that is not necessary to process your enquiry.

purposes.title: Why do we use your data?
purposes.intro: Your data is processed for the following purposes:

items.contact: to receive and respond to your enquiries;
items.quote: to understand your needs and prepare a response or quote;
items.followUp: to communicate with you and follow up on your enquiry;
items.contract: to take the pre-contractual steps you request and, if you accept a proposal, to prepare for or perform a contractual relationship;
items.security: to ensure the website's security, proper operation and maintenance where technical data is processed for these purposes;
items.legal: to comply with legal obligations and protect Impact Words' rights in the event of a dispute, where necessary.

purposes.outro: Your data must not be reused for purposes incompatible with those for which it was collected. Any additional use requiring separate information or a distinct legal basis will be handled through the appropriate measures.

legalBases.title: What are the legal bases for processing?
legalBases.intro: Depending on the processing activity, your data is processed on one of the following legal bases:

precontractual.label: Pre-contractual steps:
precontractual.text: when you request a quote or wish to discuss a potential service, the necessary data is processed to respond to your request.

legitimateInterest.label: Legitimate interests:
legitimateInterest.text: certain data may be processed to respond to a general enquiry, secure the website, prevent misuse or handle a complaint, after balancing these interests against your rights and interests.

legalObligation.label: Legal obligation:
legalObligation.text: where applicable law requires certain information to be retained or disclosed.

consent.label: Consent:
consent.text: where required, particularly for certain non-essential cookies or trackers, or for another use that requires your agreement.

legalBases.outro: You may choose not to provide certain information. However, if it is necessary to respond to your enquiry or prepare a quote, your decision may prevent us from processing your request.

retention.title: How long do we retain your data?
retention.intro: Data is retained only for as long as appropriate to fulfil its purpose, subject to applicable legal obligations.
retention.clientText: If your enquiry results in a service engagement, certain data may be retained throughout the contractual relationship and then archived for the periods required by legal, accounting or tax obligations and to establish, exercise or defend legal claims. Retention periods vary depending on the document concerned.
retention.technicalText: Retention periods depend on the hosting provider, security tools and actual configuration. They must be defined according to security requirements and applicable obligations.
retention.outro: At the end of the applicable retention period, data is deleted or anonymised unless further retention is necessary or required by law.

recipients.title: Who can access your data?
recipients.intro: Your data is accessible only to those who need it for the purposes described in this policy.

company.label: Impact Words:
company.text: to process enquiries, communicate with you and manage business follow-up.

providers.label: Technical service providers:
providers.text: the providers actually used for hosting, form submissions, email, website maintenance or security, to the extent required for their assigned tasks.

authorities.label: Competent authorities:
authorities.text: where required by law or an enforceable decision.

recipients.outro: The relevant providers must be identified based on the website's actual configuration. Your data is not sold to third parties.

transfers.title: Hosting and transfers outside the European Union
transfers.paragraph1: The website is hosted by Vercel. Depending on the technical configuration, the services enabled and the providers involved, certain technical data or information submitted through the website may be processed in countries outside the European Union, including the United States.
transfers.paragraph2: Where personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, the transfer must rely on a mechanism compliant with the GDPR, such as an applicable adequacy decision or appropriate contractual safeguards, depending on the transfer and the provider concerned.
transfers.paragraph3: The specific arrangements must be verified against the contracts, deployment settings and privacy documentation of the providers actually used. General information about the hosting provider is available in the

rights.title: What are your rights?
rights.intro: Subject to the conditions and limitations set out in applicable law, you may request:

items.access: access to the personal data concerning you;
items.rectification: correction of inaccurate or incomplete data;
items.erasure: erasure of your data where the relevant conditions are met;
items.objection: objection to processing based on legitimate interests, on grounds relating to your particular situation;
items.portability: data portability where this right applies;
items.withdrawal: withdrawal of your consent at any time where processing is based on consent, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before its withdrawal.

rights.contactOutro: and specify your request. Where necessary, we may ask for additional information to verify your identity in a proportionate manner.
rights.responseTime: We generally respond within one month. This period may be extended in accordance with the GDPR, particularly where a request is complex or numerous requests have been received.
rights.complaintIntro: If, after contacting us, you believe your rights have not been respected, you may lodge a complaint with the French Data Protection Authority (CNIL) through

security.title: Data security
security.content: Impact Words implements technical and organisational measures appropriate to its activities to protect data against loss, alteration, disclosure or unauthorised access. As no transmission or storage system can guarantee absolute security, measures are tailored to the risks and the tools actually used.

cookies.title: Cookies and other trackers
cookies.paragraph1: Cookies or other trackers may be used to provide certain features, remember preferences, protect the website or measure its audience. The tools actually in use must be verified before this policy is published.
cookies.paragraph2: Trackers that are strictly necessary for the requested service may be subject to different rules from non-essential trackers. Where consent is required, the relevant trackers must not be placed before consent has been obtained.
cookies.paragraph3: If the website uses a consent management tool, you will be able to change your choices through the cookie management mechanism provided on the website. This mechanism must actually be installed and functional before it is described as available.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.content: This policy may be updated to reflect changes in data processing, the tools used or applicable legal obligations. The date of the latest update appears at the top of this page. Where a substantial change requires specific notification, affected individuals will be informed through appropriate means.

footer.title: Questions about your personal data?
footer.text: Contact Impact Words to exercise your rights or request further information about how your data is processed.
